records.methods: Case report of a third-ventricle colloid cyst with an associated remnant; the abstract states no technique (title and abstract only).

records.terminology: Uses 'paraphysis cerebri' for a human remnant ('in man') and lists the paraphysis among neuroepithelial candidate origins of colloid cysts, alongside ependyma and choroid plexus; no location or definition is given in the abstract.
records.caveats: Abstract only; the criteria (histology, immunostaining, imaging) on which the remnant was identified as paraphysis are not in the abstract. appraisal.note: Abstract only; the paraphysis identification is explicitly a belief ('which we believe corresponds'), so it is an interpretation of a single case.

The attribution of the 'lacks uptake mechanisms' clause to Jansen and Diederen rests on citation placement. Hasunuma et al. 2010 is R467 in this corpus, whose abstract says only V2-type receptor and 'possibly the main site of cerebrospinal fluid production'; the 'osmotic and/or ionic regulation' wording is this paper's, not that abstract's.
